title: Chapter 750 Coincidence; Becoming A Father Again!
content:
Chapter 750 Coincidence; Becoming A Father Again!

Chapter 750  Coincidence; Becoming a Father Again!

On an ordinary planet.

Tao Qian, who was wearing a long robe, was drinking fine wine and humming a tune. He was extremely relaxed.

At this moment, a stream of light entered his body.

In the next moment…

He was stunned.

This was because this stream of light was the information gathered by his many clones.

From the information, he learned about the battle situation in the Buddha Realm and the Demon Realm, as well as the announcement of the Buddha Saint King's sarira and the Demon Saint King's heart.

One had to know that the Buddha Saint King's relic and the Demon Saint King's heart were just information that Tao Qian had randomly fabricated.

In the end, it was actually true?

Could it be that the relic and the Heart of the Demon Saint King really had such miraculous effects?

Tao Qian rubbed his chin.

Then, he shook his head repeatedly.

What was he thinking? This was just something he made up.

In this world, how could there be any equipment that could withstand all defenses? How could there be anything that could make a person become a Saint King in one step?

Then, Tao Qian silently drank the fine wine with an intoxicated expression.

Even Tao Qian, the initiator of this, was almost interested in the Buddha Saint King's relic and the Demon Saint King's heart.

There was no need to talk about those Holy Masters who were kept in the dark.

Almost all the Sacred Lords placed their attention on the Buddha Realm and the Demon Realm.

It was no wonder that this was the case. The temptation of these two things was too great.

....

On the other hand.

Fire God Palace.

All the members were gathered here. Their expressions were solemn and excited.

Because today, they officially had a new Palace Master, Li Ke!

Even though Li Ke did not have extremely powerful strength.

However, his talent, his progress, and his ability were obvious to everyone.

Everyone believed that Li Ke could lead the Fire God Palace to become one of the most powerful forces in the world!

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, a fiery red light flashed past the hall and landed steadily on the main seat at the top. It gradually condensed into a robust figure.

He was Li Ke!

Everyone from the Fire God Palace knelt on the ground and called out respectfully,""Greetings, Palace Master!"

Li Ke looked around and felt that there were all black heads. He said,"Stand up!"

"Thank you, Palace Master!" All the disciples said in unison.

An old man with slightly white hair took a step forward and said,""Palace Master, now that the Buddha Realm, the Demon Realm, the Ocean Realm, and other great worlds are fighting, in addition to the legends of the Buddha Saint King's sarira and the Demon Saint King's heart, how should our Fire God Palace deal with them?"

Li Ke naturally knew about these things.

He wasn't too interested in war.

However, the Buddha Saint King's Relic and the Demon Saint King's Heart made him think of something.

However, he didn't want to get them himself. He wanted to give them to Lin Fan.

That was because in Li Ke's heart, Lin Fan had the highest status. His cultivation was unfathomable and at the same time, he had given him a new lease of life.

Although Li Ke now had considerable power and strength.

But in his eyes, he was still far from Lin Fan.

All these years, Li Ke had always wanted to repay Lin Fan.

Unfortunately, there was nothing suitable.

The Buddha Saint King's Relic and the Demon Saint King's Heart were not bad.

Therefore, Li Ke said," The battle between the Demon Realm, the Ocean Realm, and the Buddha Realm is extremely dangerous, but sometimes, danger is also an opportunity! Once we seize this opportunity, it's not impossible for our Fire God Palace to regain its glory and even surpass the past!"

His voice was loud and infectious, causing everyone's emotions to surge.

It was as if he could already see the scene of the Fire God Palace obtaining a great opportunity and standing at the top of the world.

....

Water God Palace.

Many of the elders who were originally leisurely received the Palace Master's mission to lead a team out to pay attention to the movements of the Demon Realm and the Buddha Realm.

A round-faced elder named Rika sighed.""I don't know when it will end."

During this period of time, he had been running around every day.

Not only that, but he also frequently encountered attacks from the demons and the Great Buddha. He was almost injured several times.

He didn't like this kind of life where he was on tenterhooks.

"There will be a day when it ends," Ma Zheng said with a smile."

"There will always be, but I don't know if I can see it," Lika said helplessly."

After a pause, he continued," Others would rather not lead the team. Elder Ma, you're a newly promoted elder. You can reject it. Why are you here?""

Ma Zheng smiled." Because I don't think this is a bad thing. In times of peace, we might not be able to contribute much even after thousands of years. Now, we're gaining something almost every day."

These words could barely be considered Ma Zheng's sincere words.

This was because he had joined Raincloud Sanctum in the beginning, then became an Altar Master, and now he was an elder. He had gained his position step by step through battles.

However, there was one thing that Ma Zheng did not mention. The reason why he wanted to join in and pay attention to the movements of the Demon Realm and the Buddha Realm was because he wanted to know the location of the Buddha Saint King's Sarira and the Heart of the Demon Saint King. The best way was to obtain them and hand them over to his master, Lin Fan!

Ma Zheng and Li Ke's thoughts actually coincided.

"Elder Ma, you're the one who's open-minded."Lika shook his head.

....

Lin Fan had no idea what was happening in the outside world.

At this moment, he was cultivating in seclusion in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

"Phew!"

"Suck!"

He quickly circulated the Ethereal Breathing Technique and continuously increased his cultivation.

50 years passed in a flash.

In these 50 years, Lin Fan had obtained 35 Transcendence Golden Bodies, 10 Imperial Weapons, 20 King Weapons, 5 Saint Weapon Upgrade Gems, and 5 Saint Skill Upgrade Gems from the system.

His strength had increased in all aspects.

For the past 50 years, Lin Fan had spent most of his time cultivating. He was extremely hardworking.

His strength had also increased greatly because of this hard work, reaching the eighth level of the Imperial level.

Lin Fan's initial plan was to enter the Holy Lord state within a thousand years.

Now, in less than 200 years, he had already reached level eight of the Imperial level. This speed was really shocking, even exceeding his expectations.

This made Lin Fan even more confident in protecting Earth and his family.

"Dong dong dong!"

On this day, there was a sudden knock on the door of the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes. A dazzling golden light flashed like the sun.

He saw…

Outside the door, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Kailin, and the others were all extremely anxious.

Thus, he took a step forward and appeared in front of them.

Without waiting for Lin Fan to speak, Kailin said,""The yellow spirit is about to give birth."

Kathleen had always been curious and envious about having children.

Now that someone was finally going to give birth, she was more excited than anyone else.

When Lin Fan heard that, his spirit spread out quickly and locked onto Huang Ling who was in a villa not far away.

As expected, her stomach turned into a ball, and a life form full of vitality was about to appear.

He... He was going to be a father again!
